run_f0_vq_training: run the F0 vector quantizer training script with a config file and checkpoint path
train_quantizer_model: train a Quantizer model for F0 reconstruction using MSE loss and commit loss
resume_checkpoint_training: resume training from a saved checkpoint using the g_ prefix checkpoint files
distributed_gpu_training: train the F0 quantizer across multiple GPUs using DistributedDataParallel
validate_f0_model: validate the F0 quantizer model and log metrics to TensorBoard during training
